onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set cc_style to {{cc_style}}]
Set the camera framing style to {{cc_style}} by adjusting ThirdPersonCamera.shoulderOffset.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set cc_collision to {{cc_collision}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.enableCollision to {{cc_collision}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set cc_pitch to {{cc_pitch}}]
Set camera pitch range to {{cc_pitch}} by adjusting minPitch and maxPitch on ThirdPersonCamera.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set cc_follow to {{cc_follow}}]
Set camera follow speed to {{cc_follow}} by adjusting translationSpeed and rotationSpeed on ThirdPersonCamera.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set ct_distance to {{ct_distance}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.targetDistance to {{ct_distance}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set ct_height to {{ct_height}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.shoulderHeight to {{ct_height}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set ct_sensitivity to {{ct_sensitivity}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.mouseSensitivity to {{ct_sensitivity}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set ct_fov to {{ct_fov}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.fieldOfView to {{ct_fov}} degrees.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/category.schema.json, set ct_rotation_speed to {{ct_rotation_speed}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.rotationSpeed to {{ct_rotation_speed}}. Higher = snappier camera.
